---
title: "HTTP API reference"
description: "Create scans, authorize capture, and retrieve results."
---

Use the API base URL provided for your integration. Keep API access tokens on your backend and send them in the Authorization header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_ACCESS_TOKEN
```

All IDs are strings. JSON requests use `Content-Type: application/json`.

## Permissions

| Scope | Access |
| --- | --- |
| `scans:create` | Create scans |
| `scans:capture` | Authorize document capture |
| `scans:read` | Read scan progress |
| `scans:results:read` | Read verification results |
| `scans:list` | List accessible scans |

Scopes apply within the venues granted to your integration. For credential setup, see [Connect your backend](./backend).

## Create a scan

`POST /v1/scans` · Scope: `scans:create`

| Body field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `venue_id` | Yes | Venue receiving the scan |

```json
{ "venue_id": "128000000000000000" }
```

Response: `201 Created`.

```json
{ "id": "128000000000000001" }
```

## Authorize capture

`POST /v1/scans/{scan_id}/capture-authorizations` · Scope: `scans:capture`

| Body field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `origin` | Yes | Registered capture-page origin |
| `capture_key_thumbprint` | Yes | `thumbprint` received from the SDK callback |
| `country` | No | Selected issuing country; ISO two-letter code |
| `document_type` | No | Selected document-type enum value |

Response: `200 OK`.

```json
{
  "access_token": "CAPTURE_ACCESS_TOKEN",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 3600
}
```

`expires_in` is the returned token lifetime in seconds. Use the actual response value; it may be shorter than the example.

Return this response and the configuration string to the SDK using your [authorization handler](./backend#add-the-authorization-endpoint).

### Document-type values

| Value | SDK constant | Document |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | `DocumentType.DRIVERS_LICENSE` | Driver’s license |
| 3 | `DocumentType.ENHANCED_DRIVERS_LICENSE` | Enhanced driver’s license |
| 4 | `DocumentType.STATE_ID` | State or provincial ID |
| 5 | `DocumentType.PASSPORT_BOOK` | Passport |
| 6 | `DocumentType.PASSPORT_CARD` | Passport card |
| 7 | `DocumentType.PERMANENT_RESIDENT_CARD` | Permanent resident card |
| 11 | `DocumentType.VISA` | Visa |
| 12 | `DocumentType.OTHER_TRAVEL_DOCUMENT` | Other travel document |

Use values returned by the SDK’s document selection state. Availability is described in [Supported documents](./documents).

## Read scan progress

`GET /v1/scans/{scan_id}` · Scope: `scans:read`

Response: `200 OK` with the current scan state. The progress fields are:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scan_id` | `string` | Scan ID |
| `seed_accepted` | `boolean` | Initial document capture accepted |
| `capture_complete` | `boolean` | All required images accepted |
| `complete` | `boolean` | Processing finished |
| `required_sides` | `number[]` | Requested sides: `1` rear, `2` front |
| `accepted_sides` | `number[]` | Accepted sides |

## Retrieve a result

`GET /v1/scans/{scan_id}/result` · Scope: `scans:results:read`

Response: `200 OK`. See [Handle results](./results) for the response fields and completion handling. `402 Payment Required` indicates that result access requires a purchase.

## List scans

`GET /v1/scans` · Scope: `scans:list`

| Query parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before` | No | Return scans older than this ID |

Returns up to 50 records in descending ID order:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "128000000000000001",
    "venue_id": "128000000000000000",
    "created_at": "2026-09-08T12:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

Use the last record’s ID as `before` to request the next page.

## Error responses

| Status | Meaning | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `401` | Missing, expired, or invalid credential | Obtain valid authorization |
| `402` | Result purchase required | Resolve account access before retrieving the result |
| `403` | Operation not permitted | Check the credential’s scopes and venue access |
| `404` | Resource unavailable to this credential | Check the stored scan ID and its ownership |
| `409` | Conflicting capture | Resume through the SDK or continue in the active window |
| `422` | Invalid request or document evidence | Correct the request or follow SDK recovery guidance |
| `429` | Request rate limited | Retry with backoff |
| `5xx` | Temporary service error | Retry with backoff, preserving the scan ID |

Check HTTP status before decoding a body; some failures have an empty body. For errors during camera capture, use the SDK’s `ErrorCode` and the [troubleshooting guide](./recovery).
